customMedia.usage: Explicit local file selection only; no upload or persistence; reload requires reselect
customMedia.formats: PNG/JPEG/WebP/AVIF up to 40 MiB; MP4/WebM/Ogg up to 300 MiB with browser-supported codec; SVG and animated image formats excluded
customMedia.lifecycle: Decode candidate before promotion; failure retains previous valid background; object URLs released on replacement/clear; muted looping video with pause control; reduced motion, offscreen, hidden and print pause playback
customMedia.controls: Fit cover/contain, opacity, choose/replace/clear; shared refraction slider; global default remains dot-grid

gradientWaves.source: Gary-UI original ambient waves (MIT): three Canvas 2D wave sheets with additive harmonic geometry, quadratic curve interpolation, gradient shading and optional deterministic grain
gradientWaves.usage: Explicit user opt-in for showcase only; never change the default dot grid
gradientWaves.defaultWavePalette: Background Lab silver preset: amplitude 2, waveScale 1.35, waveRatio 0.6, swell 0, turbulence 50, tilt 1.12, zoom 1, height 10, fogDepth 20, speed 0.1, brightness 1.1, dark opacity 0.47, medium detail, grain enabled at 0.01, mouse interaction disabled with stored parallaxStrength 0.85. Light uses its silver colors and opacity 0.32. Global scene remains dot-grid; direct engine defaults are exposed through GaryGradientWaves.defaults.
gradientWaves.garyRecipe: Background Lab Gary preset: amplitude 2.6, waveRatio 1, swell 0, turbulence 50, tilt 1.23, zoom 1.4, height 11, dark opacity 0.6, grainIntensity 0.02, no mouse interaction or parallax, medium detail; light opacity 0.32 with the Gary palette
gradientWaves.controls: horizonColor, waveColor, crestColor; speed, amplitude, waveScale, waveRatio, swell, turbulence, tilt, zoom, height, fogDepth, brightness, opacity, parallaxStrength, grainIntensity; mouseInteraction and grain toggles; low/medium/high detail; pause/play/replay/reset, JSON configuration export and PNG snapshot including configured opacity
gradientWaves.api: window.GaryGradientWaves exposes mount(host, options), defaults, ranges as [min,max,step] arrays and normalize(patch, base); mount returns state getter, update(patch), pause(), play(), replay(), snapshot() and destroy(); state contains status, time, frames, options, width and height; the host emits gary-waves-status and gary-waves-state
gradientWaves.lifecycle: No renderer starts until mount. Playback is continuous with a 30 fps cap and no duration limit; render scale is the minimum of devicePixelRatio and the detail cap (low 0.75, medium 1.25, high 2). Hidden, offscreen, disconnected and print states suspend rendering; reduced motion and zero speed render a static complete frame, with no pointer parallax under reduced motion. Resize and return to visibility restore the appropriate frame; destroy removes owned canvas, listeners and observers.
gradientWaves.fallback: Unavailable Canvas 2D or a rendering failure reports fallback; the shared background controller retains the dot grid and offers explicit retry
gradientWaves.baselineGuard: No typography, navigation, card geometry or global-default changes

flowGrid.interaction: pointer-local dot displacement and brightness, event-driven redraw only
flowGrid.theme: one dot field on pure black/white; no line mesh or contour field
flowGrid.fallback: CSS dots only when Canvas is unavailable; never render both

material.default: One local interactive dot grid over a pure theme background

variants.selector: CSS radial dot pattern when Canvas is unavailable
